cases.name: Jane Doe 611UFCA aka Jane Doe No. 51
cases.narrative: On 1/13/1975, her nude body was found dumped at the side of the road off the 700th block of West Artesia Boulevard and Wilmington Avenue in Los Angeles, CA. She had been deceased just hours before her discovery. Investigators determined she had likely been thrown from a moving vehicle, which proved to be the fatal injury, not the two shots to the head.
